title: Craft Blend 2-Mix Duo #26 (ThaiBenjarong+SwedishKurbits / KlimtMosaic+YorubaAdireEleko)
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 3:4 aspect ratio.

A photograph of TWO women standing side by side on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Left woman: a real adult Emirati woman in her mid 40s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, smoky bronze eyes, a soft nude lip, warm golden-tan skin, an elegant composed expression, cool and composed, warm honey-blonde hair styled in vintage victory rolls framing the face, real living eyes. Long oval nails, chrome finish.

Left woman's physique: An extraordinarily tall and enormous woman, far beyond any real person, towering and broad. A commanding, statuesque frame with huge broad shoulders, powerful thick arms with hard defined muscle, a strong deep chest, and a long, dense, muscular torso with only a slight inward taper at the waist. Enormous powerful hips and colossal long thighs with hard muscle visible through a soft layer, thick strong calves. Not slim, not delicate, powerful, statuesque and imposing. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Left woman's body art: Her bare skin is painted in two different patterns covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere. Her upper body, from her collarbones down to her waistline, is painted in Thai Benjarong porcelain (a black ground with five-colour jewel enamels in lotus-petal motifs), wide gold bands following every deep crease, dense tiered lotus-petal work filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin. Her lower body, from her waistline down to her ankles, is painted in Swedish Dalarna kurbits folk painting (a deep barn-red ground with bold cream and gold curling scrollwork), wide gold bands following every crease, dense curling floral scrollwork filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin. Rather than a sharp boundary, the two painted patterns blend gradually into each other across a soft irregular zone a few inches wide, motifs from each pattern scattered into the other's territory, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, face unpainted.

Left woman's pose: caught mid-jump, feet off the ground.

Left woman's footwear: extreme needle heels, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Center woman: a real adult Swedish woman in her early 50s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, very pale, cool skin, a soft white-silver highlighter along the cheekbones, nose bridge and brow bones, pale icy-blue eyeshadow with a fine silver shimmer, pale softly brushed blonde brows, curled light-brown-tipped lashes, large pale-blue eyes with bright real catchlights, a sheer frosted pale-pink lip, a cool, calm, faraway expression, cheerful, rich chocolate-brown hair styled in a chin-length bob, real living eyes. Long coffin nails, glossy finish.

Center woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Every part of her is dramatically oversized at once: a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in sharply even at this size. Below that waistline, enormous round hips flare out more than three times the width of the waistline, gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a full round face. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Not a plus-size model, an overwhelming maximalist hourglass. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Center woman's body art: Her bare skin is painted in two different patterns covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere. Her upper body, from her collarbones down to her waistline, is painted in Klimt-inspired organic mosaic (an organic mosaic of small irregular tesserae with gold-leaf borders), wide gold bands following every deep crease, dense organic curved mosaic filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin. Her lower body, from her waistline down to her ankles, is painted in Yoruba adire eleko pattern (a deep indigo ground with bold cream resist-painted geometric motifs), wide cream bands following every crease, dense geometric bird motifs filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin. Rather than a sharp boundary, the two painted patterns blend gradually into each other across a soft irregular zone a few inches wide, motifs from each pattern scattered into the other's territory, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, face unpainted.

Center woman's pose: back fully to camera.

Center woman's footwear: extreme platform stiletto heels, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, all faces toward the camera.

Lighting: the blended painted patterns reading crisp against each woman's skin, the hard raking light carving every fold and curve. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 3:4 8K.
